image_description: An interior view of a bakery display case filled with various cakes, pastries, and breads. The foreground features a glass counter with multiple tiers of desserts, including chocolate-topped cakes and fruit tarts. Behind the main counter, there are metal shelving units holding trays of baked goods. In the background, a worker in blue is visible near a preparation area. A digital clock displaying '15:08' is mounted on the upper right wall. The lighting is artificial and slightly yellowish, typical of commercial food displays.

Some of the chocolate shavings and fruit toppings on the central cakes have a slightly smudged or 'painted' texture rather than distinct physical pieces, though this is subtle.
